headline.title: The 12-month window
headline.summary: Many AI startups are emerging in areas not yet covered by existing foundation models, but this trend is expected to change as these models continue to evolve. Industry experts suggest that the current 12-month window for innovation in these niches may soon close as foundational technologies advance.

articles.title: Palantir posts mini-manifesto denouncing inclusivity and ‘regressive’ cultures
articles.summary: Palantir has released a statement criticizing inclusivity and what it describes as "regressive" cultures, reflecting its controversial stance amid its collaborations with agencies like ICE. The company's ideological position has faced increased scrutiny as it asserts its role as a defender of Western values.

articles.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Uber enters its assetmaxxing era
articles.summary: Uber is entering a new phase focused on maximizing its assets, emphasizing the integration of AI in its operations. The article discusses the implications of this shift for the future of transportation.

articles.title: The RAM shortage could last years
articles.summary: A report from Nikkei Asia indicates that despite increased DRAM production efforts, manufacturers are projected to meet only 60 percent of demand by the end of 2027, with potential shortages extending until 2030, according to SK Group's chairman. Major memory producers, including Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, are actively working to expand their production capacities.

articles.title: Tesla brings its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston
articles.summary: Tesla has expanded its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston, adding to its existing operations in Austin. The service, which allows rides without safety drivers, was launched in January 2026.

articles.title: Anthropic’s relationship with the Trump administration seems to be thawing
articles.summary: Anthropic continues to engage in discussions with senior officials from the Trump administration, despite being classified as a supply-chain risk by the Pentagon. This indicates a potential thawing of their previously strained relationship.

articles.title: It Takes 2 Minutes to Hack the EU’s New Age-Verification App
articles.summary: A security analysis reveals that the European Union's new age-verification app can be hacked in just two minutes. The article also highlights significant data breaches at a gym chain and a hotel giant, alongside a disruptive DDoS attack on Bluesky and concerns over questionable hires by ICE.

articles.title: AI chip startup Cerebras files for IPO
articles.summary: AI chip startup Cerebras has filed for an initial public offering (IPO) following recent agreements with Amazon Web Services to utilize its chips in data centers and a significant partnership with OpenAI valued at over $10 billion. The IPO filing marks a key step for the company as it seeks to expand its market presence.

articles.title: The App Store is booming again, and AI may be why
articles.summary: New data from Appfigures indicates a significant increase in app launches in 2026, potentially driven by advancements in AI tools. This resurgence suggests that AI may be playing a key role in revitalizing the mobile software market.

articles.title: Schematik Is ‘Cursor for Hardware.’ Anthropic Wants In
articles.summary: Schematik is a new program designed to assist users in coding for physical devices, likened to a "cursor for hardware." Anthropic has expressed interest in the development of this tool.
